chapter.verse: Abraham a puanbuk kongkhak-ah sun nisat laitak, tu-in a om lai takin Mamre tawsawte' gei-ah ama' tungah Topa kilang hi.
Amah khuadak to hi, en in, mi thum ama' mai-ah na ding hi. Amah in amaute a muh ciangin amaute' dawn dingin puanbuk kongkhak panin va tai a, lei lakah kun sukin,
“Ka Topa aw, nong hehpihna-in na nasempa hong kheng kei in.

Na nasempa' kiang hong tung khin na hih buangun—na thahat kik nadingun an tawm khat ka va lak kikal sungin tui tawmkhat la sakin na khe uh sil un la, sing nuai-ah khawl un, tua khit ciangin paisuak un,” ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in, “Na cihbangin hong hih in,” ci uh hi.
Puanbuk sunga Sarah’ kiangah Abraham pai mengmeng a, “Annel hoihte lawh thum hong bawl mengmeng in la, meek manin mohin hong bawl in,” ci hi.
Abraham bawnghon lakah tai-in bawngno a dawng a hoih khat la a, a nasempa' tungah manlang tak-a a na bawl pah dingin pia hi.
Tua ciangin, amah in bawngnawi-thaukhal, bawngnawi, a minsa bawngno sa la-in amau’ mai-ah lui hi; amaute in a nek lai takun sing nuai-a amau' kiangah amah ding hi.
Amaute in ama' kiangah, “Na zi Sarah koi-ah om ahi hiam?” ci uh hi. Amah in, “Puanbuk sungah om hi,” ci hi.
Topa in, “Tu zawh kum khat, kumkik ciangin kong pai kik taktak ding a, na zi Sarah in tapa khat nei ding hi,” ci hi. Sarah in ama' nung puanbuk kong-ah na ngai hi.
Tu-in Abraham leh Sarah teek uh a, a kum uh ham hi; Sarah a numei ngeina teng tawpta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Sarah amahmah nui-in, “Kei ka teek khit, ka topa zong a teek khitin nopsakna nei ding ka hi hiam?” ci hi.
Topa in Abraham' tungah, “Bang hangin Sarah nui-in, ‘Tu-in kei teek ka hih ciangin ta nei takpi ding ka hi hiam,’ ci ahi hiam?
Na khatpeuh peuh Topa ’ adingin haksa lua ahi hiam? A kisehsa kumkik ciangin nang' kiangah kong pai kik ding a, Sarah in tapa khat nei ding hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin Sarah in nialin, “Ka nui kei hi,” ci hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah lau hi. Amah in, “Hi lo hi, na nui mah hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua mun panin mite paikhia a, amaute in Sodom lam en uh hi; amau’ pai nading lampi-ah a kha dingin Abraham in amaute va zui hi.
Topa in a lungsimah, “Abraham a lian a thahat minam suakin, leitung minam khempeuh in ama' tung tawnin thupha ngah ahih manin, tu-a ka hih ding thu Abraham’ tungah im ding ka hi hiam?

Im kei ning. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Abraham’ tunga a ciamsa thu a tun’sak theih nadingin ama' khit-a a tate leh a innkuanpihte in thuman leh thutang-a nasepna tawh Topa ’ thupiakte a zuih theih nadingun a hilh dingin amah ka teel khin hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, “Sodom leh Gomorrah a kimawhsakna lianin amaute’ khialhna nasia mahmah hi, kici ahih manin,
kei' tunga hong kigen bangin amaute gamta takpi uh hiam ci-in a thei dingin ka paisuk ding hi; tua bang ahih kei leh, ke’n ka thei ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua panin mite kihei-in Sodom lamah pai uh hi; ahih hangin Topa ’ mai-ah Abraham ding lai hi.
Tua ciangin Abraham in hong naihin, “Thuman mite mi gilote tawh susia khawm takpi ding na hi hiam?
Gentehna-in, khuapi sungah thuman mi sawmnga om leh; tua sunga om thuman mi sawmngate’ hangin khah loin tua mun susia teitei ding na hi hiam?

Thuman mite in mi gilote tawh a kibat nadingin mi gilote tawh thuman mite thah khawm ding, hi thei ahi hiam? Tua pen hi thei lo ding hi. Leitung khempeuh Thukhenpa a manin gamta lo ding ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Topa in, “Sodom khuapi sungah thuman mi sawmnga ka muh leh, amaute’ hangin tua mun buppi ka khah ding hi,” ci hi.
Abraham in thu gen a, “En in, leivui leh vut ahi lel keimah in Topa ’ tungah thu kong gen ngamna hong maisak in.

Gentehna-in, thuman mi sawmnga sung panin nga om kei leh? Tua nga a om loh manin khuapi buppi na susia veve ding hiam?” ci hi. Amah in, “Tua sungah sawmli-le-nga ka muh nak leh ka susia kei ding hi,” ci hi.
Ama' kiangah thu gen kikin, “Gentehna-in, tua sungah sawmli kimu leh,” ci hi. Amah in dawngin, “Sawmlite’ hangin ka hih kei ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “ Topa heh kei in, thu kong gen ding hi. Gentehna-in, tua lai-ah sawmthum kimu leh,” ci hi. Amah in dawngin, “Sawmthum ka muh leh ka hih kei ding hi,” ci hi.
Amah in, “En in, Topa tungah thu kong gen ngam lailaina hong maisak in. Gentehna-in, tua lai-ah sawmnih kimu leh,” ci hi. Amah in dawngin, “Sawmnihte’ hangin ka susia kei ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, “ Topa heh kei in, hih khat vei bek thu hong gensak lai in. Gentehna-in, tua lai-ah sawm kimu leh,” ci hi. Amah in dawngin, “Sawmte’ hangin ka susia kei ding hi,” ci hi.
Abraham' tungah a thugen ding a man khit ciangin ama' paina dingah Topa pai a, Abraham zong ama' innah ciahkik hi.
